shown.blurb: Google Cloud NetApp Volumes is integrated with Unified Maintenance . This integration supports the Flex Unified, Flex File, Standard, Premium, and Extreme service levels. You can view upcoming and past planned maintenance events for your storage pools in Cloud Hub, and track event logs and configure automated alerts in Cloud Logging.
